top_signals.title: Saudi Aramco Profit Rises 9%
top_signals.summary: Saudi Aramco posted a 9% increase in third-quarter profit following a jump in earnings from its refineries and as the Iran war drove oil prices higher. The company’s oil selling price was about 35% higher in the quarter from a year earlier. Bloomberg's Mitchell Ferman reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
